look.summary_zh: 暖色 · 压暗中灰 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 95.6/255（变化 -31.9 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.196。中灰红减蓝 +125.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #FFC49B、#ED7E07、#642E00；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #A85E00、#FD4900、#F98600。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 95.6/255 (-31.9 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.196; mid-gray red minus blue +125.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #FFC49B, #ED7E07, #642E00. Red/green/blue swatches: #A85E00, #FD4900, #F98600.
look.suggested_use_zh: 暖色生活、餐饮与怀旧试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
